texte: Prompt Upgrade + Auto Model mods are exactly what I want to experiment with 🔥 Been following Trent Calloway’s content too, and building tools that improve your workflow instead of just adding more prompts feels like the next level..

🚨 UPDATE ON AUTO MODEL 🚨: A few of you made a great point in the comments. Claude’s cache is tied to the model, so when Auto Model switches models in the middle of a long session, the new model has to reread your whole conversation, and switching back and forth can end up costing more than it saves. Auto Model really should only pick the model at the start of a session.  So if you're building it yourself, please keep that in mind and I’ve put the Auto Model prompt on hold.
